apps.name: DDG SUPER Native Agent
apps.subtitle: DuckDuckGo iOS with native Agent button
apps.localizedDescription: Unsigned DuckDuckGo iOS build from duckduckgo/apple-browsers tag 7.210.0+ios. v0.4.1 adds a launch-safe delayed native Agent button plus internal DOM probe for page snapshot/copy/share.
